headline: Nifty eyes 23,200 resistance as geopolitical risks, crude oil, and earnings drive market sentiment ahead of Diwali

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Geopolitical risks, crude oil prices, and corporate earnings are set to steer equity markets this week.
Nifty faces key resistance around 23,200 as traders evaluate whether bulls can push indices higher.
Investors are eyeing a potential market rebound ahead of the upcoming Diwali week.
Global cues from Wall Street and historical S&P 500 performance trends are impacting D-Street expectations.
whatHappening: Coal India's mining output jumped 19% following a recovery from the monsoon slump.
Affle 3i announced an all-cash agreement to acquire Israel's Perion Network for $420 million.
Crude oil prices hovering above $116 and rising India VIX reflect ongoing volatility.
Foreign institutional inflows and buying in blue-chip stocks helped support market rebounds.
summary:
Indian markets enter the week of November 2-6 looking to overcome volatility and build momentum ahead of Diwali.
Geopolitical concerns, crude oil prices over $116, and earnings results remain key macro factors for benchmark indices.
Stock-specific triggers include Coal India's 19% production increase and Affle's $420 million cross-border acquisition.
